title: Breakfast of Champions
author: Kurt Vonnegut
summary: Car dealer Dwayne Hoover is slipping into madness just as science fiction writer Kilgore Trout arrives in town for an arts festival. Vonnegut narrates in a playful way and adds his own drawings.
readIf: you like short, strange satire with a deadpan voice and a bleak view of human folly.
skipIf: you want a conventional plot or find crude humour distracting.
